description_en: Cancel an Intelligent Contact Robot calling job
description_zh: 取消智能联络机器人呼叫任务
name: CancelTask

parameters.description_en: The unique job ID of the robot calling task. You can view it in the [Task Management](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) interface or obtain it by using the [CreateTask](~~223556~~) API.
